payloads.players: data/<slug>/players_live.json -> players[] (one competition); data/lab/<window>/<scope>.json -> rows with `fields` (one row per person, cross-competition)
payloads.roles_and_value: data/value/lines.json -> rows [id, comp, tid, min, apps, gar90, gar, par, pct, role, prev90, rt, c]; data/value/players.json -> rows (fields incl. role, gar90, min)

league_strength.competition_pages: percentiles within competition and season, by fine role
league_strength.cross_competition: pooled over the view's competitions; rates in ADJUSTED_KEYS (goals, npG, assists, xG, npxG, xA, xGOT, shots, key passes, big chances per 90) multiplied by the row's `factor` (pool.json factor_att, minutes-weighted) before ranking; gar90 is already on the pooled scale; other rates unadjusted
league_strength.evidence: 144 players who changed league between seasons (12 pooled leagues): the factor-adjusted rate correlates better with next season's in every attacking metric tested (npxG+xA/90 0.68 -> 0.73, shots+key passes 0.75 -> 0.82, value/90 0.53 -> 0.70) and the absolute error falls 5-20%; the log change regresses on the log factor ratio with slope 1.1-1.7, so the factor if anything under-corrects

groups.peer_group: role in {CB} (formation role: the one started in most); within competition and season on competition pages, pooled across the view's competitions with attacking rates league-adjusted in cross-competition views
groups.position_source: data/value/lines.json `role` (per competition line) or data/value/players.json `role` (12 months), joined on player id. A coarse role (DF, MF, FW) means no formation start (substitute appearances only): such players are almost never over the minimum (none of 5,150 league lines with 900+ minutes lacked a fine role), so show no percentile card for them; list them under Sofascore's letter `position` (G, D, M, F). Do not map letters to fine groups: 40% of D-lettered regulars are full-backs, 45% of M-lettered are AM/W or wing-backs, 32% of F-lettered are wingers

minimum.note: and over the view's floor (players_live minutes_floor = 30% of the season's minutes; lab rows' floor). Flag 'small sample' under 900 minutes.

groups.basis: per 90 minutes (ratios from summed numerators and denominators)

metrics.explanation: Goals of expected goal difference a player adds per 90 minutes over a replacement-level player in the same role, from the site's player value model (box score plus match rating).

predictive.target: next-season value per 90 (the site's player value model)
